findings.summary: The path-traversal check uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator, so sibling directories like /cache/out_evil pass and members can be written outside the output directory; the same flawed check appears in the Rar (261), 7z (337) and tar (108) checks.

findings.summary: If all members are blocked, the 7z targets list is empty and py7zr may treat an empty list as no filter, extracting everything including malicious entries; extraction should be skipped when targets is empty.
